references.text: The same encouragement from the father to strengthen himself with food before departure, which is repeated throughout the visit
The continuation of this scene where the father-in-law again asks them to wait until the day turns toward evening
Abraham offers his guests bread to strengthen their hearts; the same expression 'strengthen your heart' is used regarding hospitality
Lot shows hospitality by insisting that the guests stay, following a similar pattern of hospitality
The prophet from Judah refuses to eat and drink, in contrast to the hospitality shown here
